_comment: Every custom value the client website template uses. 'existing' values are already in the review-automation snapshot; 'new' values were created in the Meridian AI Solutions sub-account on 24 Oct 2026 with these examples. GHL derives the key from the name (lowercase, spaces to underscores), so names must not change once pages reference them. 'example' is only used for the local preview build and as the starting value in the template sub-account. Avoid double quotes and < > in values: GHL inserts them as-is, and the JSON-LD block would break on a stray quote.

values.name: Site Service 1 Desc
values.example: Leaks, cracked tiles and broken flashing found and fixed fast, with photos before and after.

values.name: Site Service 1 Body
values.example: Most leaks start small: a cracked tile, a lifted flashing or a blocked valley. We find the cause, show you photos and fix it properly so it doesn't come back next storm. Every repair gets a fixed written price before we start.
values.help: Two to four sentences unique to this service, used on its own page. Unique copy is what lets each service page rank

values.name: Site Service 2 Desc
values.example: Clean, repair, re-point and re-coat to add 15+ years to your roof for a fraction of a replacement.

values.name: Site Service 2 Body
values.example: A restoration brings an old tile or metal roof back to near new. We pressure clean, replace broken tiles, re-bed and re-point the ridge caps, then apply a sealer and two coats of membrane paint in the colour you choose.
values.help: Two to four sentences unique to this service, used on its own page. Unique copy is what lets each service page rank

values.name: Site Service 3 Desc
values.example: Full tile-to-metal and metal-to-metal replacements with a clean site every day.

values.name: Site Service 3 Body
values.example: When a roof is past repair, we strip it back and replace it with new Colorbond or tiles. We check the battens and gutters while it is open, keep the site tidy each day and handle the council paperwork.
values.help: Two to four sentences unique to this service, used on its own page. Unique copy is what lets each service page rank

values.name: Site Service 4 Desc

values.name: Site Service 4 Body
values.example: After hail or wind damage we make the roof safe quickly, then document the damage with photos and a written report your insurer can use. We can work directly with your insurer's assessor.
values.help: Two to four sentences unique to this service, used on its own page. Unique copy is what lets each service page rank

values.name: Site Service 5 Desc
values.example: New gutters, downpipes and guards that stop overflow and protect your foundations.

values.name: Site Service 5 Body
values.example: Overflowing gutters cause rot, leaks and foundation damage. We replace gutters and downpipes in Colorbond, fit leaf guards and make sure water runs away from the house.
values.help: Two to four sentences unique to this service, used on its own page. Unique copy is what lets each service page rank

values.name: Site Service 6 Desc
values.example: Detailed photo reports for buyers, sellers and insurers, usually within 48 hours.

values.name: Site Service 6 Body
values.example: Buying, selling or just worried? We inspect the whole roof, including flashings, valleys and the roof space, and send a photo report within 48 hours with clear priorities and prices.

values.name: Site FAQ 3 A
